structuralIssues.note: The sheet is two stacked blocks of the same 11 stops (2 observations each), separated by a repeated header row. Columns A('0') and C('1') are empty junk index columns; B (Bus_Stop_Name) and D (Sequence) had no header text. All handled by the normalizer.

leakageRisk.recommendation: Use GroupKFold(groups = Bus_Stop_Name). A random row split puts the same stop+label in train and test and inflates accuracy. With only 11 unique stops, any model is a pipeline demonstration, not a trustworthy predictor (§4).

provenance.note: Data_Status declares all numeric attributes synthetic/estimated; only stop name + sequence are sourced. No value in this dataset is 'observed'.

modeling.sampleSizeWarning: 11 unique stops is far too small to claim real ML accuracy. State this in the UI/docs rather than overclaiming (§4).
